# WLog: Workout Tracker & Gym Log

> WLog is a workout tracker and gym log app for iOS and Android, built for lifters who want fast, distraction-free logging and clear progress tracking.

## Key Facts
- Available on: iOS (App Store) and Android (Google Play)
- Price: Free with optional premium features
- Developer: Independent developer
- Contact: wlog.training@gmail.com
- App Store ID: 1567930312
- Bundle ID: com.mdikcinar.workoutplanner
- Rating: 4.7/5

## Core Features
- AI-powered workout import: scan photos, PDFs, or spreadsheets to create routines automatically
- Automatic progressive overload: custom weight increments per exercise, applied after each successful session
- Linked sets: ratio-based weight sync between warm-up and work sets
- Full set tracking: weight, reps, sets, RPE, RIR, rest timer, supersets, drop sets, failure sets
- Plate calculator: see exact plates to load for any barbell weight
- Personal records: track 1RM, best set volume, session volume, with strength level (Beginner to Advanced)
- Body measurements: weight, body fat, arms, chest, waist — with charts over time
- Custom workouts: build any routine, support for 5x5, PPL, powerlifting, hypertrophy, bodyweight
- Apple Watch companion: start workouts, log sets, track rest from your wrist
- Cloud backup and cross-device sync

## Supported Languages
English, German, French, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Dutch, Polish, Danish, Russian, Turkish, Japanese, Korean, Hindi, Chinese (Simplified)

## Privacy & Data Handling
- WLog does not sell personal data and does not share workout or health data with advertisers or data brokers.
- The app contains no third-party advertising.
- An account is optional: workouts are stored on-device, and sync to a private cloud backup only when signed in.
- Health data (Apple Health / Health Connect) is opt-in and is never used for advertising or marketing.
- Accounts and all cloud data can be deleted in-app: Settings > scroll to bottom > Delete account.
- Subscriptions are billed by Apple or Google and must be cancelled in the respective store account.
- Full policy: https://wlog-workout-tracker.github.io/en/privacy/

## Health & Safety Notice
WLog is not a medical device and does not provide medical advice. Suggested weight increases are derived
solely from logged numbers and cannot account for fatigue, technique or readiness. Users should consult a
physician before starting an exercise program.
